transcript: If you wake up every day feeling unhappy, listen closely. There is nothing wrong with you. This is not a curse. It is not a defect in your mind. And it is not something that automatically needs to be silenced. Sometimes unhappiness is not depression. Sometimes it is awareness. It is your inner life quietly telling you that you are living beneath what you know you're capable of. The world has taught you that discomfort means something is broken. That if you feel restless or dissatisfied, you must numb it, label it, or explain it away. But discontent can be a signal, a form of energy, a reminder that something in your life needs to change. Many people who went on to build meaningful lives did not escape their unhappiness. They listened to it. When you feel stuck, overlooked, or out of place, it does not mean you have failed. It often means you are not meant to stay where you are. Do not silence that feeling too quickly. Do not turn away from it in fear. Let it move you. Let it guide your next step. Because unhappiness is not always a weakness. Sometimes it is the beginning of movement. If this spoke to something inside you, the way back to stillness is there for you. It's not motivation, it's guidance. You'll find it in the link on my profile.
